Relive every South Africa try from Rugby World Cup 2019 in Japan.
From powerful forward carries to brilliant backline moves, watch every try scored by the Springboks on their unforgettable journey to becoming Rugby World Cup champions for the third time.
South Africa battled their way through the tournament before delivering a dominant performance against England in the final, winning 32–12 to lift the Webb Ellis Cup in Yokohama.
Keep up-to-date on all things rugby by following World Rugby on social
